Wir haben aber auch ein großes Angebot an BIO-Limonaden sowie auch eine wechselnde, hausgemachte Limonade. Unsere Gerichte verfeinern wir gern mit frischen Kräutern, gerösteten Nüssen, frischen Sprossen sowie hausgemachten Dips.

deals.description: With the next exhibition (opening tonight!) we again offer an extended program: Slide through all dates, join us for one of the curator's tours or save the first dates for 2027! 🌳 There are also a few last spots for the workshop with Beatrice Tulagan (19 Nov, 14:00!) – register via mail to ail@uni-ak.ac.at 🌳 AIL, Otto Wagner Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 (closed on public holidays, free entry) ail.angewandte.at About the exhibition 'Future on Trial. Between Unruly Evidence and Unfinished Climate Justice’: Contributions by: adO/Aptive, Beatrice Tulagan, Eline Benjaminsen, Elias Kimaiyo, Forensic Architecture, Jonas Staal, Paolo Cirio, Prin Rodriguez, Radha D’Souza, Valentino Skarwan Curators: Adriano Vinca, Camille Belmin, Elisabeth Falkensteiner Expert and scientific support: Inga Menke, Jameela Joy Reyes, Krishna Ariola, Michaela Krömer, Nicholas Petkov The engagement with climate justice reveals a complex field of perspectives across multiple temporalities, geographies, and forms of knowledge. In this context, environmental destruction is entangled with economic interests, the uneven distribution of risks and responsibilities, colonial continuities, imperialist power relations, and geological deep time. The exhibition Future on Trial. Between Unruly Evidence and Unfinished Climate Justice moves between two conceptions of justice. One that is produced and negotiated in courtrooms through scientific and legal evidence, data, and visual investigations, and another that understands justice as an unfinished, collective process, grounded in Indigenous knowledge, queer ecology, multispecies perspectives, and activism. Through a dialogue between artistic practices and scientific experts in the field of climate litigation, the exhibition opens up a space between evidence and uncertainty, accusation and repair, institutional accountability and collective imagination. deals.title: Al Kunsthistorisches di Vienna è facilissimo perdersi i capolavori
deals.description: Al Kunsthistorisches di Vienna è facilissimo perdersi i capolavori. Salva questa lista 👇 🖼️ COSA VEDERE 1. Torre di Babele – Pieter Bruegel il Vecchio 2. Cacciatori nella neve – Pieter Bruegel il Vecchio 3. L’arte della pittura – Jan Vermeer 4. Madonna del Prato – Raffaello 5. Saliera – Benvenuto Cellini 6. Madonna del Rosario – Caravaggio 7. Davide con la testa di Golia – Caravaggio 8. L’Estate – Giuseppe Arcimboldo 9. Adorazione della Santissima Trinità – Albrecht Dürer 10. L’Infanta Margherita Teresa in abito azzurro – Diego Velázquez 11. Testa di Medusa – Pieter Paul Rubens 12. Collezione egizia 13. Collezione di antichità greco-romane 📌 INFO UTILI 📍 Maria-Theresien-Platz, di fronte al Museo di Storia Naturale 🚇 U2/U3 Volkstheater oppure U2 Museumsquartier 🎟️ Intero 22 € online, 24 € in cassa, gratis per chi ha meno di 19 anni ⏰ 10:00–18:00, il giovedì fino alle 21:00. Fino al 4 gennaio è aperto tutti i giorni 💡 Prenditi un caffè nel café sotto la cupola: da solo vale la visita 💾 Salva il reel per il tuo viaggio a Vienna e mandalo a chi viene con te. 👉 Seguici! Per altri reel come questo ❤️ #vienna #wien #kunsthistorischesmuseum
